entities.summary: Arthur Clive Heward Bell was an English art critic, associated with formalism and the Bloomsbury Group. He developed the art theory known as significant form. Clive Bell was a painters & sculptors from Great Shefford (1881-09-16, Great Shefford–1964-09-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
